entries.name: School
entries.description: A low two-storey red-brick school campus with two broad wings and a small central clock turret. School entrance has normal 2.1m personnel doors; each floor is3m. Two or three big grouped window bays, not fine mullions.

entries.name: Hospital
entries.description: A broad modern pale hospital with four 3m storeys, a large red medical cross, low connecting wings and a restrained ambulance canopy. Repeat normal-sized windows across its larger width.

entries.name: Police station
entries.description: A three-storey blue-grey civic police station with a simple slate roof, small radio mast and a clear dark blue entrance canopy. Ordinary2.1m doors.

entries.name: Fire station
entries.description: A low red-brick fire engine hall: two4.2m vehicle bays clearly distinct from its much smaller2.1m personnel door, a simple hose-drying tower, broad grey roof.

entries.name: Stadium
entries.description: A compact open green sports arena with simple two-tone terraces, a broad ring roof and four distinct floodlight towers. All personnel entrances stay small2.1m high; no spectators or fine seat rows.

entries.name: Church
entries.description: A pale stone church with a long nave, strong slate roof, tall slender bell tower and simple arched windows. A normal2.1m side personnel doorway provides scale; no giant entrance doorway.

entries.name: Village pub
entries.description: A compact two-storey timber-and-plaster village pub with a dark green pitched roof, broad simple facade timber bands and a large quiet amber hanging sign with no text.

entries.name: Grocer
entries.description: A small two-storey pale plaster grocer with a green-and-cream broad striped awning and one broad dark shop window. No crates, tiny fruit, lettering or separate roof tiles.

entries.name: Bakery
entries.description: A small two-storey warm brick bakery with a terracotta roof and broad cream-and-ochre awning; clear large warm shop window, no tiny bread loaves or tile courses.

registration: Original disconnected RGBA pixels retained. A measured doorway factor is uniform for every complete cutout in a source family/footprint tier; alpha bounds locate ground contact only, never choose scale.
